headlines.title_en: Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development: China's real estate has entered the stock era
headlines.summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a press conference in its series on "Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan." Chen Shaowang, spokesperson and vice minister of the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, said at the press conference that the housing and urban-rural development cause mainly has three major segments: urban and rural construction, housing and real estate, and the construction industry. All three major segments are in a critical period of transformational development, summarized as "two shifts, two transformations, and three transformations."

headlines.summary: 9月18日，住房和城乡建设部房地产市场监管司司长‌张雪涛在国新办新闻发布会上表示，“十五五”时期将推动住房公积金管理服务提质增效。通过数字赋能，简化住房公积金提取手续，缩短贷款的办理时限，推行缴存记录在全国范围内的互认互信，推动住房公积金的转移接续、异地贷款等业务的高效办理。（e公司）

headlines.title_en: MOHURD: During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, procedures for housing provident fund withdrawals will be simplified and loan processing times shortened
headlines.summary_en: On September 18, Zhang Xuetao, director of the Real Estate Market Supervision Department of the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, said at a State Council Information Office press conference that during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, the management and services of housing provident funds will be improved in quality and efficiency. Through digital empowerment, the procedures for withdrawing housing provident funds will be simplified, the time limit for processing loans will be shortened, deposit records will be mutually recognized and trusted nationwide, and the efficient handling of business such as housing provident fund transfers and continuation, and off-site loans will be promoted. (e Company)

headlines.title: 高盛：美联储加息可能放缓金价涨势 但不会使其止步
headlines.summary: 高盛维持其2027年底金价5400美元/盎司的预测不变。高盛表示，尽管美国最新加息，但更紧的货币政策可能会放缓黄金涨势，却不会改变其长期上涨的判断。高盛在报告中表示，预计“更紧货币政策的影响主要将体现为黄金短期升值路径放缓，而非终端金价下调”；各国央行持续推进储备多元化，仍是其看好黄金的主要结构性驱动因素。高盛指出，如果美联储采取更加鹰派的政策，黄金可能出现更大幅度的回调。若美联储今年再加息三次，并释放终端利率将进一步上升的信号，金价可能跌至约4070美元/盎司；但随着各国央行持续购金支撑市场，金价预计将在2026年底回升至约4200美元/盎司。

headlines.title_en: Goldman Sachs: Fed rate hikes may slow gold price gains but will not stop them
headlines.summary_en: Goldman Sachs maintained its forecast of $5,400 per ounce for gold by the end of 2027 unchanged. Goldman Sachs said that despite the latest U.S. rate hike, tighter monetary policy may slow gold's rally but will not change its long-term bullish view. Goldman Sachs said in a report that it expects "the impact of tighter monetary policy will mainly be reflected in a slower short-term appreciation path for gold, rather than a lower terminal gold price"; continued reserve diversification by central banks remains its main structural driver for being bullish on gold. Goldman Sachs noted that if the Federal Reserve adopts a more hawkish policy, gold could see a larger correction. If the Fed raises rates three more times this year and signals that the terminal rate will rise further, gold prices could fall to about $4,070 per ounce; however, as central banks continue buying gold to support the market, gold prices are expected to rebound to about $4,200 per ounce by the end of 2026.

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development: Sales of completed homes are the general trend
headlines.summary_en: A relevant official of the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development introduced that in commercial housing sales, the completed-home sales system will be advanced to solve the problem of "paying with one hand and receiving the home with the other" in project sales, realize "what you see is what you get," and fundamentally prevent delivery risks. Completed-home sales are the general trend. According to National Bureau of Statistics data, in recent years the sales area of completed homes has maintained positive growth, and its share of new home sales area has increased year by year. New projects should give priority to completed-home sales, and support policies for projects such as land, finance and taxation should be coordinated and used well; for those implementing pre-sales, pre-sale fund supervision should be improved to effectively safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of homebuyers.

headlines.title: 9月18日午间新闻精选
headlines.summary: 【9月18日午间新闻精选】1、截至午间收盘，沪指涨1.04%，深证成指涨1.52%，创业板指涨2.11%；科创50指数涨3.93%。2、港股午间收盘，恒生指数涨0.67%，恒生科技指数涨1.74%。3、住房和城乡建设部在新闻发布会上介绍，我国房地产进入存量时代。现房销售是大势所趋。4、国家能源局等部门部署煤炭安全稳产保供工作。5、工业和信息化部等十部门印发《医药工业发展“十五五”规划》，其中提到，加快人工智能、量子计算、超级计算、计算医学等新技术赋能药物研发，探索超限制造、太空制药、生物制造等药械生产新模式。

headlines.title_en: Midday news highlights for September 18
headlines.summary_en: [September 18 Midday News Highlights] 1. As of the midday close, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 1.04%, the Shenzhen Component Index rose 1.52%, and the ChiNext Index rose 2.11%; the STAR 50 Index rose 3.93%. 2. At the Hong Kong midday close, the Hang Seng Index rose 0.67%, and the Hang Seng Tech Index rose 1.74%. 3. The Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development said at a press conference that China's real estate has entered the stock era. Completed-home sales are the general trend. 4. The National Energy Administration and other departments deployed work on safe and stable coal production and supply. 5. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and nine other departments issued the "15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Pharmaceutical Industry," which mentioned accelerating the empowerment of drug R&D by new technologies such as artificial intelligence, quantum computing, supercomputing and computational medicine, and exploring new pharmaceutical and medical device production models such as unlimited manufacturing, space pharmaceuticals and biomanufacturing.

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong stocks midday review: the Hang Seng Index closed up 0.67%, with chip stocks surging.
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, September 18 - In today's morning session, the Hang Seng Tech Index opened higher and then fluctuated upward, rising more than 2% at one point. As of the midday close, the Hang Seng Index rose 0.67%, and the Hang Seng Tech Index rose 1.74%. Chip stocks surged, with Iluvatar CoreX (09903.HK) up more than 13%, Biren Technology (06082.HK) up more than 9%, and Hua Hong Semiconductor (01347.HK) up more than 6%; the optical communications sector strengthened, with Lightelligence-P (01879.HK) up more than 17%; AI stocks rebounded, with MINIMAX-W (00100.HK) up more than 13%, and Zhipu (02513.HK) up more than 6%; in addition, liquid cooling, innovative drugs, telecommunications equipment, Chinese brokerage, intelligent driving, commercial aerospace, new consumption and other sectors were among the top gainers. headlines.summary_en: China's August gasoline exports were 700,000 tons, down 17.5% year-on-year; cumulative gasoline exports from January to August were 2.42 million tons, down 57.4% year-on-year. August aviation kerosene exports were 2.55 million tons, up 41.4% year-on-year; cumulative aviation kerosene exports from January to August were 11.76 million tons, down 14.4% year-on-year. August diesel exports were 1.33 million tons, up 42.1% year-on-year; cumulative diesel exports from January to August were 4.84 million tons, up 5.9% year-on-year. August naphtha imports were 700,000 tons, down 55.2% year-on-year; cumulative naphtha imports from January to August were 8.41 million tons, down 22.4% year-on-year.
